items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: I heard uh those Muggsy Spanier records that I mentioned the ragtimers and I thought wow this is a whole different thing and I liked that

ctx.x: did you have any idols when you were coming up

oh yeah I um it's funny I sort of worked backwards in my um taste I was first attracted to Harry James he played you know fantastic trumpet player let's face it man played brilliantly and I thought that was really great and then I heard uh those Muggsy Spanier records that I mentioned the ragtimers and I thought wow this is a whole different thing and I liked that and then finally I worked my way back to uh some Louis Armstrong and the Hot Five and Hot Seven things like that really liked those and then started…
